an3.95:1.3: Aggavatī parisā, vaggā parisā, samaggā parisā.
an3.95:2.2: Idha bhikkhave yassaṃ parisāyaṃ therā bhikkhū na bāhulikā honti na sāthalikā vokkamane nikkhittadhurā paviveke pubbaṅgamā, viriyaṃ ārabbhanti appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya -- tesaṃ pacchimā janatā diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjati,
an3.95:2.3: sā pi hoti na bāhulikā na sāthalikā vokkamane nikkhittadhurā paviveke pubbaṅgamā, viriyaṃ ārabbhati appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
an3.95:3.2: Idha bhikkhave yassaṃ parisāyaṃ bhikkhū bhaṇḍanajātā kalahajātā vivādāpannā aññamaññaṃ mukhasattīhi vitudantā viharanti -- ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave vaggā parisā. 3.
an3.95:4.2: Idha bhikkhave yassaṃ parisāyaṃ bhikkhū samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā khīrodakībhūtā aññamaññaṃ piyacakkhūhi sampassantā viharanti -- ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave samaggā parisā. 4.
an3.95:5.1: Yasmiṃ bhikkhave samaye bhikkhū samaggā sammodamānā khīrodakībhūtā aññamaññaṃ piyacakkhūhi sampassantā viharanti bahuṃ bhikkhave bhikkhū tasmiṃ samaye puññaṃ pasavanti,
an3.95:5.2: brahmaṃ bhikkhave vihāraṃ tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhū viharanti -- yadidaṃ muditāya cetovimuttiyā
an3.95:5.3: pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati. 5.
an3.95:6.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave upari pabbate thulla-phusitake deve vassante taṃ udakaṃ yathāninnaṃ pavattamānaṃ pabbatakandarapadarasākhā paripūreti, pabbatakandarapadarasākhā paripūrā kussubbhe paripūrenti, kussubbhā paripūrā mahāsobbhe paripūrenti, mahāsobbhā paripūrā kunnadiyo paripūrenti, kunnadiyo paripūrā mahānadiyo paripūrenti, mahānadiyo paripūrā samuddam paripūrenti,
an3.95:7.1: evam eva kho bhikkhave yasmiṃ samaye bhikkhū samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā khīrodakībhūtā aññamaññaṃ piyacakkhūhi sampassantā viharanti bahuṃ bhikkhave tasmiṃ samaye puññaṃ pasavanti,
an3.95:7.2: brahmaṃ bhikkhave vihāraṃ tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhū viharanti -- yadidaṃ muditāya cetovimuttiyā,
an3.95:7.3: pamuditassa pīti jāyati pītimanassa kāyo passambhati passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati.
